PreceptDef.label: balance: sacred
PreceptDef.description: Harmony among opposed forces is the central virtue of the Covenant.

PreceptDef.label: extremism: abhorrent
PreceptDef.description: Those who serve only light, only shadow, only order, or only ruin are viewed as spiritually dangerous.

PreceptDef.label: many paths: respected
PreceptDef.description: Different callings are necessary parts of the divine weave.

PreceptDef.label: corpses: respected
PreceptDef.description: A corpse must be handled with care. Desecration of the dead is a grave sin.

PreceptDef.label: funerals: required
PreceptDef.description: The soul's passage must be witnessed by the living.

PreceptDef.label: tombs: sacred
PreceptDef.description: Burial places are houses of memory, not storage rooms for the forgotten.

PreceptDef.label: nature: respected
PreceptDef.description: Plants, animals, and rivers are lesser verses in the same hymn as mortals.

PreceptDef.label: pollution: abhorrent
PreceptDef.description: To poison the land is to tear the Covenant's green scripture.

PreceptDef.label: hunting: ritualized
PreceptDef.description: Hunting is permitted, but the slain beast should be thanked and used well.

PreceptDef.label: labor: divine
PreceptDef.description: Work is a liturgy of hand, tool, and will.

PreceptDef.label: crafting: honorable
PreceptDef.description: The maker's art reflects Thrain and Dvalin's sacred endurance.

PreceptDef.label: idleness: shameful
PreceptDef.description: Rest has its place, but wasted purpose dulls the soul.
